mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_execution_event (run_id, proposal_id, event_type, result_status, object_type, object_id, summary, error_code, occurred_time, create_by) VALUES (#{runId}, #{proposalId}, #{eventType}, #{resultStatus}, #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{summary}, #{errorCode}, #{occurredTime}, #{createBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, proposal_id, event_type, result_status, object_type, object_id, summary, error_code, occurred_time, create_by FROM t_ai_execution_event WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY occurred_time ASC, id ASC
